title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
location: Centre, PA; Clinton, PA

details.description:
SVRCTP

The National Weather Service in State College PA has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
North central Centre County in central Pennsylvania...
Central Clinton County in north central Pennsylvania...

* Until 515 PM EDT.

* At 428 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Keating,
moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Keating, Monument, Glen Union, and Orviston.

Radar has indicated rotation within this severe thunderstorm.
Although a tornado is not immediately likely, tornadoes can develop
quickly during severe thunderstorms.
details.instruction:
Stay inside a well built structure and keep away from windows.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this severe
thunderstorm. Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's
leading killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close
enough to be struck by lightning.

Very heavy rainfall is occurring with this severe thunderstorm, and
may lead to flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

title: Hazardous Seas Warning
location: Coastal waters from Cape Blanco OR to Pt. St. George CA out 10 nm; Waters from Cape Blanco OR to Pt. St. George CA from 10 to 60 nm

details.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and
steep to very steep seas 7 to 10 ft through Sunday evening,
then north winds 15 to 25 kt with steep seas 6 to 9 feet
Sunday night and Monday.

* WHERE...All areas will experience conditions hazardous to small
craft. But, very steep seas are expected south of Port Orford
and beyond 5 nm from shore beginning late this afternoon and
continuing through Sunday evening.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 5 PM PDT Monday.
For the Hazardous Seas Warning, from 5 PM this afternoon to 11
PM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Very steep and hazardous seas could capsize or
damage vessels. Bar crossings will become especially
treacherous.

* View the hazard area in detail at https://go.usa.gov/x6hks
details.instruction:
Recreational boaters should remain in port. Commercial vessels
should prepare for very steep seas and consider remaining in port
until conditions improve.

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Brewster County in southwestern Texas...
Southeastern Jeff Davis County in southwestern Texas...

heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain

roads. Find an alternate route.

location: Muscatine; Scott; Keokuk; Washington; Louisa; Jefferson; Henry; Des Moines; Van Buren; Lee; Rock Island; Mercer; Henderson; Warren; Hancock; McDonough; Scotland; Clark

details.description:

* WHERE...Portions of northwest and west central Illinois, east
central and southeast Iowa, and northeast Missouri.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM CDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat
illnesses.
details.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Take extra precautions when outside. Wear lightweight and loose
fitting clothing. Try to limit strenuous activities to early morning
or evening. Take action when you see symptoms of heat exhaustion and
heat stroke.

creeks.
